findings.description: Critical: Non-main requests originally supplied no immutable selector even though migration 030 permits multiple policy and pipeline fingerprint variants for one repository, namespace, and revision.
findings.resolution: Require index_id for feature and work-package namespaces and validate the selected record's complete identity. Add request-schema and no-arbitrary-selection tests.

findings.description: Critical: The coordinator depended on Docker-only source copying for code_search_pkg while the package asyncpg pin conflicted with the coordinator and no implementation package owned the dependency boundary.
findings.resolution: Declare code-search-pkg as a supported monorepo path dependency, widen and test the shared asyncpg compatibility range, regenerate both locks, install the wheel in Docker, and add clean-environment import tests.

findings.description: Critical: Authentication alone did not prevent a valid principal from choosing another repository and read_allow=['**']; caller-provided scope was not bound to server authority.
findings.resolution: Make caller scope a narrowing only. Require a principal-bound server grant for repository, namespace, read ceiling, and deny rules, apply the same identity model to direct MCP, and return 403 before semantic work when no grant exists.

findings.description: Critical: Work-package scope resolution lacked an immutable repository and revision trust root and could otherwise authorize stale or cross-repository paths.
findings.resolution: Bind resolution to repository, change, package, and the full source Git revision; reject runtimes without a durable resolver and reserve durable registration for RI08 without failing open.

findings.description: Critical: Dynamic capability had no refresh, invalidation, timeout, backoff, cancellation, or recovery semantics, so startup state could remain stale or external calls could hang.
findings.resolution: Define bounded provider and index readiness TTLs, exponential failure backoff, immediate query-failure invalidation, configurable external-operation deadlines, overload limits, transition tests, and bounded shutdown.

findings.description: Critical: The first OpenAPI draft admitted contradictory ready/fallback/scope and availability/status documents, which would undermine body-aware capability detection.
findings.resolution: Constrain every search state with fallback/current/result/scope invariants and publish status as discriminated oneOf variants with an exact truth table. Add contradictory-document tests.

findings.description: Critical: The first plan omitted the agent-coordinator delta and had stale task scenario references plus a capability package that could run before the runtime status surface.
findings.resolution: Add full modified coordinator requirements, remap tasks to scenarios 1-21, assign authorization/timeout/observability tests, bind capability implementation to the frozen status contract, and require integration to verify both packages together.

findings.description: Nit: Status existed without bounded-cardinality metrics, transition logs, or explicit prohibitions on sensitive query and source data.
findings.resolution: Add D12, privacy-preserving state/latency evidence, transition logging, and no-sensitive-log tests.

findings.description: The plan correctly separates loop-owned HTTP and direct-MCP runtimes, avoids a second runtime in HTTP-proxy mode, prohibits legacy reads, and validates freshness before embedding.
findings.resolution: Preserve these boundaries during implementation and implementation review.
